sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.214 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned ADJ-4-cum-Special Court under POCSO Court, Bhubaneswar, arising out of Nayapalli P.S. No.93 of 2023, for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363/376(2)(n)
of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.
3. This Court takes note of the birth certificate of the son of the Petitioner and the victim who is stated to have attained marriageable age in the meanwhile.

5. Learned counsel for the Petitioner is requested to serve two extra copies of the brief on the learned counsel for the State enabling him to serve the notice on the Informant through the I.O.
intimating that the matter shall be taken up on 29.10.2025.
Learned counsel for the State is requested to obtain the Case Diary in the meanwhile.
7. As an interim measure, it is directed that no coercive action shall be taken against the Petitioner in connection with the aforesaid case till the next date.
In the event requisites are not filed, as directed, the interim order shall stand vacated.
